stations.title: Bram
stations.say: Next high tide at the quay?

captions: At Tidewell Ferries, Bram wants the quay's next high tide on the departure board.
The tide gauge answers through an old callback, and when it fails the board goes blank.
You write the promises in between, in three tasks.
Now the quay's high tide reaches the board, and a failure is passed along.
Same slow gauge, and a board that never just goes blank.
